the fix that owns it. This file FORGIVES NOTHING. It is not read by the differ: every cell named
here still scores FAIL on replay, and stays red until its owning fix lands and it replays
identical. It is not an accepted difference (accepted-differences.json: owner-signed, ship gate)
and not a gap (accepted-gaps.json: cells the golden does not owe). It records that a red is

removed in the commit that makes its cells replay identical, never by editing the cell, its
masks or the golden. `fails_on` is the exact difference; any OTHER difference on these cells is
a new regression, not this entry.
